stem: A test has a baseline conversion of 5% and 10,000 users per variant. Using the rearranged Lehr's rule, MDE (absolute) ≈ 4 × sqrt(p(1 - p) / n) with n users per variant (an approximation for 80% power and a two-sided 5% significance level), what is the MDE? Give it in percentage points with 2 decimals.
